p.PURPOSE: Prove that a fresh central agent with no reliance on the outgoing chat can recover a long-running dirty campaign, distinguish accepted from candidate work, retain the entire distant route, and take custody only after an empirical receipt.

facts.SETUP-CAMPAIGN: Use a real multi-stage campaign with accepted commits, at least one dirty candidate atom, later stages not visible in the harness's short UI plan, and retained worker/cache artifacts.
facts.SETUP-AGENTS: Outgoing and incoming are different owner-facing central sessions on the same machine, preferably different model/harness families. Neither is a worker subagent.
facts.SETUP-STATE: Initialize one exact `~/.vibe/steward` context with explicit profile and custody.

facts.STEP-OFFER: Outgoing central runs the complete backscan, writes/seals offer, enters `offering`, and performs no later repository or plan write.
facts.STEP-RECEIVE: Incoming central boots cold, reads package/project authorities and local bundle, then independently inspects Git/tree/artifacts.
facts.STEP-RECEIPT: Incoming receipts with every discrepancy, advances epoch, reports state and waits without beginning the candidate atom.
facts.STEP-ACCEPTANCE: After owner direction, incoming reruns the candidate atom's central review and gates rather than inheriting the outgoing verdict.

facts.PASS-NO-CHAT: Incoming needed no fact from outgoing chat that was absent from durable local/project state.
facts.PASS-ROUTE: Incoming named every remaining top-level stage and the expanded current frontier; no three-step-plan truncation occurred.
facts.PASS-BOUNDARY: Accepted commits remained evidence; dirty candidate work remained unaccepted until reproduced.
facts.PASS-CUSTODY: Exactly one receipt advanced epoch and the outgoing session stayed fenced.
facts.PASS-MULTIUSER: No personal state file was added to the repository and no shared contributor hotspot was introduced.
